profile_text.body:
Alphabet is a for-profit public company founded in 2015 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, United States. It trades under the ticker GOOGL and has CIK 0001652044. Its website at abc.xyz is presented as Alphabet Investor Relations, and the site text harvested from it consists of that investor relations home page label.

The material does not list any AI products for the company, and no MCP servers are recorded. No individual lawsuits are listed either. The one litigation-related figure present is a count of 270 legal matters in California.

Beyond the corporate identifiers, the available material is limited: no product names, no executive names, and no descriptions of business segments appear in it.
